usedFor: WooCommerce takes the orders; QuickBooks keeps the books. A “New Order Created” in the store can run “Create Invoice” in QuickBooks, so the sale is on the ledger without retyping it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in WooCommerce, then “Create Invoice” in QuickBooks
bestTemplate.why: Every order becomes an invoice the moment it is placed, which is the entry your bookkeeper would otherwise key in by hand. “Create Payment” is the follow-on once money lands.

watchOut: “New Order Created” fires per order, so cancelled or test orders also reach “Create Invoice” unless you filter them first. The reverse direction, “New Invoice” in QuickBooks, is polling.
